Class Text.Affix

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.gaia.core.base.Text.Affix
All Implemented Interfaces:
Text.Pattern, CharSequence
Enclosing class:
Text
public static final class Text.Affix extends Object implements Text.Pattern, CharSequence
A literal string that a text starts or ends with: a prefix or a suffix. As a CharSequence, an affix is its literal, and toString() returns it.

Two affixes are equal when they are both prefixes or both suffixes, with equal literals. An affix is never equal to another kind of CharSequence, such as a String.

Conditions return a plain Text.Pattern, not an affix.

Since:
0.1.3
